title: 42 Weeks
datePolicy: This ordered timeline is the definitive source for exact working dates. Location start and end dates are inclusive. Dated events use fixed=true only when their dates must not move as the working plan is rebalanced.
locationPolicy: A location entry identifies where the family expects to sleep at the end of that calendar date. Use an explicit In transit location for an overnight travel night. A named multi-stop route may stand in for that route's individual overnight stops.
railPolicy: The calendar's left rail groups connection and overnight-travel locations into the most useful adjacent trip segment. Expanded days retain the exact underlying sleep location.
travelPolicy: Use weekends for long-haul travel and generally preserve Saturday before routine Sunday repositioning. Treat airplane work as bonus output, not a dependency. Do not spend vacation days on ordinary transfers unless a weekday itinerary materially improves the trip.

timeline.title: Weekend flight to Melbourne
timeline.context: Leave on Saturday after roughly two weeks at home following camp. Target a Monday arrival, continue to Newtown the same day, and treat airplane work as optional output. Leaving Thursday August 26 or Friday 27 remains an unselected option for one or two Melbourne hotel nights and a last-round home-and-away game on or around August 30.

timeline.title: In transit
timeline.context: Overnight flight toward Melbourne, then Newtown the same day as landing.

timeline.title: Same-day transfer Melbourne Airport → Newtown, Geelong
timeline.context: Land Monday and continue to Newtown the same day. Do not take a Melbourne rental for the selected stay.

timeline.title: Newtown, Geelong
timeline.context: First real Australia base: land Monday, live in Newtown, and make one MCG trip from here.

timeline.title: Work, homeschool and live locally in Newtown
timeline.context: Monday is landing. Protect Tuesday through Friday while using afternoons, evenings and Saturday for remembered places, Queenscliff and the MCG window.

timeline.title: Target a wildcard or early-finals MCG match from Newtown
timeline.context: Primary plan is a Newtown-to-MCG trip on the wildcard weekend, likely Friday September 3 or Saturday September 4. Leaving a few days earlier remains an option for one or two Melbourne hotel nights and a last-round home-and-away game on or around August 30; that variant is not the selected stay.
